summary: The Pure Water W9 bottleless cooler is 50.3 in high, 11.8 in wide and 15.5 in deep (1.28 x 0.30 x 0.39 m), 46.3 lb, with 2.1 gal cold and 1.3 gal hot tanks; a W9CT countertop model is 17.8 in high. The library piece uses the W9 size. One product, so other dispensers and rental water stations (barrels, jugs on stands) differ. Indoor use only is documented; it needs a power outlet. Page reported opened by a second research engine, not by Claude.
